stories.h: Mossad chief in Washington pressing to resume Iran war
stories.s: Mossad director Roman Gofman met CIA chief Ratcliffe and was due to see envoy Witkoff, reportedly sent by Netanyahu to urge renewed strikes on Iran. Israeli defense officials reportedly see no urgent need.

stories.h: 53 nations, groups demand Israel let winter aid into Gaza
stories.s: Led by the UK, Qatar and Jordan, signatories urged immediate entry of shelter, fuel and health supplies as floods swamp tents. Israel says over 93,000 tents have entered and blames Hamas.

stories.h: UTJ rabbis demand written draft-exemption pledge from Eisenkot bloc
stories.s: Agudat Yisrael advisers reportedly want all 48 bloc MKs to sign onto a blanket yeshiva exemption with a court override, far beyond what bloc parties accept, complicating Eisenkot's path to 61.

stories.h: Police post snipers on Rahat rooftops amid clan gunfire
stories.s: Israel Police stationed snipers in the Bedouin city to 'neutralize' gunmen after a month of feuding among six families that the mayor says has killed two young people.

coming.h: Security cabinet meets amid Iran strike fears
coming.s: Netanyahu's security cabinet is set to convene Sunday for the first time since October 5, as Eisenkot warns the caretaker government against launching an Iran operation.

coming.h: Knesset vote expected on Liberman as defense committee chair
coming.s: Likud blocked the vote, delaying it to Monday; until then Liberman cannot access classified briefings as chair.

coming.h: E1 settlement tender bids due to be opened
coming.s: The Israel Land Authority set November 19 to open bids for E1 housing, as Denmark and other Europeans push for an emergency UN Security Council meeting.
